data.notes: Howard County added in 2025. CWDMA includes all public and private lands in these counties.
data.management_objective: Help slow the spread of CWD through regulations and monitoring

data.description: CWD sampling conducted by approved processors
data.sampling_method: Brain stem and certain lymph nodes removed
source_materials: Deer brought by hunters to cooperating processors
data.notes: Department maintains list of approved taxidermists and meat processors in CWDMA

data.restrictions: Cannot transport whole carcasses or certain parts outside CWDMA without testing/approval
data.allowed_transport: Processed parts and approved carcasses to approved processors
data.enforcement: Violation results in penalties and disease spread prevention

data.monitoring_program: Continuous surveillance of road-kills and hunter-harvested deer
data.reporting: Results compiled into annual surveillance reports

data.office: Maryland DNR Wildlife and Heritage Service
